items.reason: Gap 0 describes two in-flight deliveries both passing the check before the id is recorded, so both process the event.
Gap 1 says the key comes from X-Event-Id, which is not signed, and describes replaying or forging it on a signed body.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, so refunds get no handler.
No gap depends on multiple processes or replicas; the concurrency raised is among queue jobs in one process.
